newsitem.title: OMAN: Renaissance to buy balance in four firms.
newsitem.headline: Renaissance to buy balance in four firms.

text.p: Renaissance Services has decided to exercise an option to buy the remaining stakes in four companies in which it already holds 51 percent, it said in a statement.

"I am pleased to inform you that the board of directors has decided to exercise this option to purchase these shares, subject to financing," chairman Samir Fancy said in a statement announcing Renaissance's maiden results.

The four companies, which are 51 percent owned by Renaissance are National Training Institute, Industrial Management Technology and Contracting Co (Imtac), Tawoos Industrial Services Co and United Media Services.
Fancy said at Renaissance's inception, its founders had negotiated an option to acquire the remaining 49 percent in these companies at a price equal to 7.5 times 1996 net audited profits.
"The company proposes to raise the required purchase price of 8.8 million rials mainly through bank borrowings, and will not issue any new capital," Fancy said.
